description: This file provides function declarations and external references for integrating the 'json-c' library with 'mustach' templating, including rendering functions to files, file descriptors, memory buffers, and custom callbacks, as well as deprecated compatibility functions.

methods.name: mustach_json_c_file
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string into a file using a JSON object as context.

methods.name: mustach_json_c_fd
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string into a file descriptor using a JSON object as context.

methods.name: mustach_json_c_mem
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string into memory buffer using a JSON object as context.

methods.name: mustach_json_c_write
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string to a custom writer callback with a JSON object as context.

methods.name: mustach_json_c_emit
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string to a custom emitter callback with a JSON object as context.

methods.name: mustach_json_c_apply
methods.description: Applies a mustache template to a JSON object with multiple callback options.
